hero.subhead: Drop your tweet, thread, or screenshot. We score it across 13 engagement signals, predict how it'll perform, and rewrite it stronger in under 30 seconds.

footer.disclaimer: letxcook grades drafts using only the engagement signals documented in X's open-source ranking repository. Numeric weights and the production model are proprietary and not used. This is a coaching tool — no result guarantees reach.

paste.title: Paste
paste.body: Drop your draft, thread or a screenshot of someone else's tweet you want to learn from. Multimodal in.

grade.title: Grade
grade.body: We score it across all 13 signals — 10 the ranker rewards, 4 it punishes — with the line that triggered each judgment.

ship.title: Ship
ship.body: Three rewrites, each strengthening a different weak signal. Copy the one that fits the angle you want.

faq.heading: Honest <emph>answers</emph>.
faq.intro: Tools in this category overpromise. We'd rather underclaim, source everything, and let you decide.

store_drafts.a: No. Drafts are sent to the grader and discarded after the response. We don't have an account system to store anything against. If we add accounts, storing drafts will be opt-in.

vs_competitors.q: How is this different from Hypefury / Tweet Hunter / Typefully analytics?
vs_competitors.a: Those tools optimize against folklore: post-time charts, hashtag counts, link-in-comments tricks — claims that aren't in X's open code. We only grade against the engagement signals X published themselves in xai-org/x-algorithm.

viral_guarantee.q: Will this guarantee my post goes viral?
viral_guarantee.a: No, and anyone who promises that is lying. We grade the signals the ranker tries to predict — that's the direction. Audience fit, timing and luck are still real. We surface what you can control.

algorithm_basis.q: Why can you say it's based on X's algorithm?
algorithm_basis.a: Because we only use the signals documented in X's open-source ranking repository at github.com/xai-org/x-algorithm. We do not have the numeric weights — nobody outside X does. We work on direction (which signals matter), not magnitude.

secret_weights.a: They're proprietary. We never guess at them. That's why every grade is a band (Weak/Moderate/Strong) instead of a percentage — we refuse to fake precision.

other_platforms.q: Can I use this for LinkedIn, Threads, or Bluesky?
other_platforms.a: Not yet. letxcook is built on X's repo specifically. We'd rather be excellent on one platform than guess on five.

bottom_cta.body: Paste your next draft. Get a verdict in 30 seconds. Ship the rewrite that hits the signals X's ranker actually predicts.
bottom_cta.trust_line: No signup · Drafts never stored · Free
